data.title: Materialise NV to Report Third Quarter 2026 Earnings on Wednesday, October 28, 2026

data.title: Auros Study Finds Consumers Wary of AI Retail Ads, but Open to AI as a Shopping Tool
data.description: In Bellevue, Washington, a recent study conducted by Auros in collaboration with Talker Research surveyed 4,000 adults from the U.S., U.K., and Australia. The study revealed that consumers are encountering AI-generated advertisements more frequently. Despite this, there is a growing skepticism among consumers about whether products marketed with AI accurately match their descriptions. The research found that 47% of individuals in the U.K., 43% in the U.S., and 42% in Australia feel deceived by products advertised using AI. This indicates a significant level of concern among consumers regarding the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated ads.

data.title: U.S. Firms Adapt to Shifting Sustainability Requirements
data.description: In Stamford, Connecticut, it has been observed that a growing number of U.S. businesses are embracing digital sustainability solutions. These technologies aim to reduce energy expenses, enhance asset efficiency, and safeguard market opportunities. The adoption of such solutions is on the rise as companies recognize the benefits they offer in terms of cost savings and operational effectiveness.

data.title: Minnesota Alliance on Problem Gambling Announces Nikki Beasley as Executive Director
data.description: In Minneapolis-St. Paul, the Minnesota Alliance on Problem Gambling (MNAPG), a nonprofit focusing on addressing problem gambling, has appointed Nikki Beasley as their new executive director. Beasley, with over 20 years of experience in leadership roles for organizations aiding those dealing with significant challenges, will now lead MNAPG in its efforts to increase awareness about problem gambling and provide resources for prevention, education, treatment, and recovery for Minnesotans. This move signals a new chapter for MNAPG as it continues its mission-driven work under Beasley's leadership.
